observations: Photo 0 shows six game controllers on a wooden table: three black, one red, one black, and one camouflage green. They match the PlayStation DualShock 4 design. No readable brand or model text is visible on them.

Photo 1 shows a black game console resembling a PS4 Slim with two controllers (one white, one silver/grey), a coiled power cable with a UK three-pin plug, on a brown surface. No readable brand or model text is visible on the console.
Both photos carry the watermark "OBATEK GLOBAL POSTED ON JIJI".
The seller's words describe the items as "Belgium UK used pads" and claim they "last longer and very durable."

claims.evidence: No origin marking, country label, or import documentation is visible in photo 0 or photo 1.
Durability cannot be judged from still photos; no usage history or test evidence is provided.

risks.risk: Controllers may not power on, connect to a console, or respond to inputs.
risks.proof: Video of each controller syncing to a console and all buttons and analogue sticks being tested.

risks.risk: Internal rechargeable batteries may be dead or unable to hold a charge.
risks.proof: Video showing a charging indicator and sustained operation while unplugged.

risks.risk: The PS4 console and cable shown in photo 1 may not be included in the sale.
risks.proof: Seller confirmation in writing whether the console is part of the lot, plus video of the console booting to the home screen.
risks.if_unproven: price as controllers only, console excluded

risks.risk: Analogue sticks or buttons may drift or be unresponsive.
risks.proof: Video of gameplay or a button-press test on each controller.

proof_requests: Video of every controller powering on and connecting to a PlayStation console
Close-up photos of any labels, stickers, or model numbers on the controllers
Written confirmation whether the PS4 console and cable in photo 1 are included
Video of the console booting to the home screen, if included
response.reason: The advertised item is identifiable as used game controllers, so they can be priced at the not-working worst case; the console inclusion and condition remain separate risks to be proven.
